name: Mukhyamantri Tirth-Darshan Yojana
description: Enables senior citizens of Madhya Pradesh to undertake free pilgrimages to major religious and spiritual destinations across India by special trains and flights.
descriptionHindi: मध्य प्रदेश के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को देश के प्रमुख तीर्थ स्थलों की निःशुल्क यात्रा (रेल एवं वायु मार्ग द्वारा) कराने की योजना।
ministry: Religious Trusts and Endowments Department, Government of MP
benefits: Free travel by train or air, complimentary accommodation, meals, guided security, and medical care for the entire duration of the pilgrimage.
benefitsHindi: यात्रा टिकट, ठहरने की व्यवस्था, भोजन, चिकित्सा सहायता और सुरक्षा का संपूर्ण खर्च राज्य सरकार वहन करती है।
eligibilityText: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above (65+ for male individuals travelling alone) who are permanent residents of MP and not income tax payers.
eligibilityTextHindi: मध्य प्रदेश के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिक जो आयकरदाता न हों।
sourceName: Tirth Darshan Portal, Government of MP
